title: Natural cycle quotient comparison for affine residue tensors
statement: Let W be a scheme, U an open and p a prime ideal of Gamma(W,U). For every complex K of modules on the localized site there is an additive isomorphism from affineResidueCycleHomology [lem-sc-affine-residue-cycle-class-quotient] to degree-one homology of terminal sections extended to p.ResidueField. The family intertwines affineResidueCycleHomologyMap [lem-sc-affine-residue-cycle-homology-map] and tensor-complex homologyMap for every chain map. Neither affinity nor perfectness is required.

proof.text: Identify residue tensor terms with ModuleCat.extendScalars by the scalar-compatible tensor identity. Tensor induction proves the differential and map equations. Restrict the term comparison to kernels and identify incoming boundary subgroups with the range of moduleCatToCycles.

Descend the kernel comparison by QuotientAddGroup.congr and compose with moduleCatHomologyIso and homologyIsoSc for degrees 0,1,2. Prove its value on explicit cycle classes. The cycle-class projection is surjective and its map formula is the existing residue map formula; homology projection naturality therefore proves the equation on every class.

lean.statement: theorem affine_residue_quotient_homology_naturality : let F : SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U) ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} Γ(W, U) := SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) letI : F.Additive := inferInstanceAs ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ _).Additive) let T := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (algebraMap Γ(W, U) p.ResidueField) letI : T.Additive := (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj _).left_adjoint_additive let G := (F ⋙ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ∃ e : ∀ K, affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+ (G.obj K).homology 1, ∀ K C (φ : K ⟶ C) z, e C (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z) = HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (G.map φ) 1 (e K z)
